opening.argument: The material presents OneCoin as a business opportunity built around recruiting team partners and strategically placing new members. Viewers are told to “send it to your future team partners,” while the interface shows person icons arranged in branching levels and describes the “Placement of new members” within a team. Alongside these recruitment and tiered-structure instructions, it presents purported commissions, earnings, and payouts, including the claim that OneCoin can transfer “comissions and earnings to your bank account.” It also sets out KYC requirements for identity documents and a utility bill. Nothing establishes that information was submitted, funds were paid, or that the earnings claims and privacy assurances were independently verified.

citations.quote: Keep this link with you at all times, and send it to your future team partners.
Placement of new members. Sometimes it can be important to strategically place people in your team.
So OneCoin is able to transfer your comissions and earnings to your bank account.
